# AeroInfo India

> AeroInfo India is a comprehensive digital platform providing interactive Indian airspace visualization, eAIP India aeronautical charts, ATS navigation routes, real-time METAR and TAF aviation weather reports, NOTAMs, RTR(A) examination resources, DGCA Air Navigation, DGCA Meteorology, and DGCA Air Regulations reference materials.

## Core Features & Information
- **AeroInfo Map App**: [AeroInfo App](https://aeroinfo.in/app) - Interactive 2D/3D map visualization for Indian airspace structures, FIR boundaries (Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai), waypoints, Navaids, ATS airways, live wind/cloud overlays, and real-time METAR/TAF weather reports.
- **eAIP India Aeronautical Data**: Electronic Aeronautical Information Publication (eAIP) charts, SID/STAR instrument approach procedures, aerodrome diagrams, and FIR frequency maps.
- **DGCA EXAMS Resources & Regulations**: Digital study and reference materials for DGCA Air Navigation, DGCA Meteorology, and DGCA Air Regulations examination topics.
- **RTR(A) Radio Telephony Reference**: Airspace sector boundaries, FIR communication frequencies, and terminal route data tailored for RTR(A) Radio Telephony Restricted (Aero) candidates and aviation professionals.
- **Disclaimer**: Intended for situational awareness, academic research, and exam reference. Not for operational flight navigation.
